name: cairn-ui
description: Accessible Vue 3 component library that also ships as native Web Components

scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.wc.config.ts
scripts.build:site: rm -rf site-dist && vite build --config vite.wc.config.ts && vite build --config vite.demo.config.ts && node scripts/build-static-htmx.mjs && storybook build --quiet -o site-dist/storybook
